questions: Should the pairs be formed to maximize the total price, or is any pairing allowed as long as we choose the maximum total among all possible pairings?
If multiple cakes have identical values for all three attributes, does pairing them yield a price based on those identical sums, or is there any tie-breaking rule?
Are the pairs ordered (i.e., does swapping a_i and b_i affect the price calculation)?
Can the same cake be used in multiple pairs if we consider different indices, or must all 2K integers be distinct?
Is the pairing required to be a perfect matching on the selected 2K cakes, or can we leave some cakes unpaired while still forming exactly K pairs?
If N is odd and K = floor(N/2), are we forced to pair all cakes, or can we leave one cake unpaired?
Does the total price sum the prices of each pair as defined, or is there any other aggregation (like average or weighted sum)?
